name: @diy-accounting-uk/web-submit-diyaccounting-co-uk
description: Submit UK tax information to HMRC

scripts.build: ./mvnw clean verify && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.formatting-fix: prettier --write . && ./mvnw spotless:apply && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.formatting:js-fix: prettier --write . && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.formatting:java-fix: ./mvnw -DskipTests spotless:apply && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.linting-fix: eslint --fix . && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.cdk:synth-environment: cd cdk-environment && npx dotenv -e ../.env -- npx dotenv -e ../.env.${ENVIRONMENT_NAME:-prod} -- npx cdk synth --require-approval never --ci true --strict --validation && cd ..
scripts.cdk:synth-application: cd cdk-application && npx dotenv -e ../.env -- npx dotenv -e ../.env.${ENVIRONMENT_NAME:-prod} -- npx cdk synth --require-approval never --ci true --strict --validation && cd ..
scripts.cdk: ./mvnw clean verify -DskipTests && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=prod npm run cdk:synth-environment && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=prod npm run cdk:synth-application && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=prod && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true && npm run clean && ./mvnw clean compile -DskipTests
scripts.cdk-ci: ./mvnw clean verify -DskipTests && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=ci   npm run cdk:synth-environment && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=ci   npm run cdk:synth-application && ENVIRONMENT_NAME=ci   && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true && npm run clean && ./mvnw clean compile -DskipTests
scripts.diagram:app-all: DEPLOYMENT_NAME=prod npm run cdk:synth-application && npm run diagram:app-auth-billing && npm run diagram:app-hmrc && npm run diagram:app-account && npm run diagram:app-ops && npm run diagram:app-delivery
scripts.diagram:app-auth-billing: npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -c -s -t cdk-application/cdk.json -co cdk-submit-application.out --stacks prod-app-AuthStack,prod-app-BillingStack -e AWS::IAM::Role AWS::IAM::Policy AWS::Lambda::Version AWS::Lambda::Alias AWS::Lambda::Permission AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm AWS::Logs::LogGroup AWS::Logs::MetricFilter AWS::Synthetics::Canary AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource -o _developers/cdk-app-auth-billing.drawio && node scripts/clean-drawio.cjs _developers/cdk-app-auth-billing.drawio
scripts.diagram:app-hmrc: npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -c -s -t cdk-application/cdk.json -co cdk-submit-application.out --stacks prod-app-HmrcStack -e AWS::IAM::Role AWS::IAM::Policy AWS::Lambda::Version AWS::Lambda::Alias AWS::Lambda::Permission AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm AWS::Logs::LogGroup AWS::Logs::MetricFilter AWS::Synthetics::Canary AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource -o _developers/cdk-app-hmrc.drawio && node scripts/clean-drawio.cjs _developers/cdk-app-hmrc.drawio
scripts.diagram:app-account: npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -c -s -t cdk-application/cdk.json -co cdk-submit-application.out --stacks prod-app-AccountStack -e AWS::IAM::Role AWS::IAM::Policy AWS::Lambda::Version AWS::Lambda::Alias AWS::Lambda::Permission AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm AWS::Logs::LogGroup AWS::Logs::MetricFilter AWS::Synthetics::Canary AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource -o _developers/cdk-app-account.drawio && node scripts/clean-drawio.cjs _developers/cdk-app-account.drawio
scripts.diagram:app-ops: npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -c -s -t cdk-application/cdk.json -co cdk-submit-application.out --stacks prod-app-OpsStack -e AWS::IAM::Policy AWS::IAM::Role AWS::Lambda::Version AWS::Lambda::Alias AWS::Lambda::Permission AWS::SQS::Queue AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource -o _developers/cdk-app-ops.drawio && node scripts/clean-drawio.cjs _developers/cdk-app-ops.drawio
scripts.diagram:app-delivery: npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -c -s -t cdk-application/cdk.json -co cdk-submit-application.out --stacks prod-app-EdgeStack,prod-app-PublishStack -e AWS::IAM::Role AWS::IAM::Policy AWS::Lambda::Version AWS::Lambda::Alias AWS::Lambda::Permission AWS::Logs::LogGroup AWS::Logs::MetricFilter AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource -o _developers/cdk-app-delivery.drawio && node scripts/clean-drawio.cjs _developers/cdk-app-delivery.drawio
scripts.diagram:environment: npm run cdk:synth-environment && bash -c 'for f in cdk-submit-environment.out/*.template.json; do npx @mhlabs/cfn-diagram draw.io -t "$f" -o "cdk-environment-$(basename $f .template.json).drawio"; done'
scripts.test: vitest --run --exclude '**/.claude/**' app/unit-tests/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*/*.test.js web/unit-tests/*.test.js app/system-tests/*.test.js
scripts.everything: time sh -c 'rm -rf package-lock.json node_modules target && ./mvnw clean && npm install && npm test && npm run docker:build && ./mvnw test && npm run test:all && npm run test:allBehaviour-proxy && npm run build && npm run cdk-ci && npm run cdk && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true && ./mvnw clean compile && npm ci && npm test'
scripts.test:all: npx vitest --run --exclude '**/.claude/**' app/unit-tests/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*/*.test.js app/system-tests/*.test.js web/unit-tests/*.test.js && npm run test:browser && npm run test:submitVatBehaviour-proxy && git restore web/public/submit.deployment-name.txt web/public/submit.environment-name.txt || true
scripts.test:unit: npx vitest --run --exclude '**/.claude/**' app/unit-tests/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*/*.test.js web/unit-tests/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage: npx vitest --coverage --run --exclude '**/.claude/**' app/unit-tests/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*.test.js app/unit-tests/*/*/*.test.js app/system-tests/*.test.js
